source.author: Dioscorides Pedianus
source.edition: Max Wellmann, Pedanii Dioscuridis Anazarbei de materia medica libri quinque, Berlin, Weidmann, 1907-1914
source.access_scope: Book I chapters 1-3 only; TEI apparatus notes excluded from the main-text trace

trace_policy.locator: Book I chapter and section; chapter 3 is one unnumbered main-text paragraph
trace_policy.role_values: Greek source terms retained; English renderings are bounded working glosses
trace_policy.uncertainty: scope, lexical, and translation uncertainty is stated; no unstated dose, vehicle, or condition is added

events.subject: ἶρις Ἰλλυρική

appearance: leaves compared with ξιφίῳ (source comparison to the named ξιφίον; no literal-sword or modern-taxon normalization)
flowers white, yellow, μήλινα (apple-like colour term; exact colour value uncertain), purple, or bluish
roles.name_relation: the variety of flower colours is given as the reason for comparison with Iris

events.scope_uncertainty: I.1 ξιφίῳ is kept opaque in this trace. The separate IV.20 ξιφίον passage provides the reciprocal source comparison to Iris as smaller and narrower; it does not authorize a literal sword reading or a modern Xiphium/Gladiolus identification.

events.subject: ἶρις roots
events.scope_uncertainty: διείραντας λίνῳ is retained as Greek; the exact action involving flax/linen is not normalized

roles.quality: Illyrian and Macedonian are better; Libyan is secondary in δύναμις (potency)

events.subject: best Iris root
events.scope_uncertainty: ὑποκόλοβος and πυρωδεστέρα are rendered descriptively, without fixing a modern botanical or pharmacological term

events.subject: ἶρις roots (scope of the plural ageing clause uncertain; not assigned to Libyan only)

roles.effect: τερηδονίζονται (become worm-eaten/decayed) but εὐωδέστεραι γίνονται (become more fragrant)

events.scope_uncertainty: The preceding sentence discusses the Libyan variety, but the following plural παλαιούμεναι is not treated as proof that ageing applies to Libya alone; the antecedent and scope remain open

events.subject: all Iris roots
events.scope_uncertainty: The passage states these general properties before the separately qualified hydromel cleansing clause; no vehicle or dose is inherited here.

events.subject: Iris roots

roles.preparation: ποτιζόμεναι μεθ᾿ ὑδρομέλιτος δραχμῶν ἑπτά (drunk with hydromel; seven drachms stated, measure referent not normalized)

events.scope_uncertainty: The seven-drachm hydromel wording is attached to the cleansing of πάχη and χολαί in this clause only; it is not a dose for every Iris effect in I.1.2.

events.subject: Iris roots
events.scope_uncertainty: These effects follow the hydromel clause without a repeated vehicle or dose; no hydromel/7-drachm condition is silently assigned to them.

events.subject: Iris roots

conditions: τοῖς γόνον προιεμένοις (a reproductive/foetal-loss condition; scope uncertain)

events.scope_uncertainty: σπωμένοις and γόνον προιεμένοις are not forced into a modern diagnosis

events.subject: Iris decoction

effects: form flesh in fistulas and cavities

branch_effects.effect: εὔθετον; μαλάσσον τοὺς τόπους καὶ ἀναστομοῦν (suitable for female fomentation; softens and opens the sites)

events.scope_uncertainty: The Greek supplies several uses in sequence; branch-to-body-site relations are kept at the stated level and no modern procedure is imposed.

events.subject: Iris roots

roles.preparation: προστεθεῖσαι ὡς κολλύριον μετὰ μέλιτος (applied/inserted in collyrium form with honey)
roles.administration: προστεθεῖσαι (application/insertion; route unresolved; not assumed to be ocular)

events.scope_uncertainty: κολλύριον names a preparation form, but this sentence does not establish ocular administration for the embryo effect; προστεθεῖσαι may indicate addition/application/insertion. The exact route and relation to later πεσσοί remain unresolved.

events.subject: Iris roots

roles.preparation: ἑφθαὶ καταπλασθεῖσαι (boiled and applied as a poultice)

events.scope_uncertainty: The separate poultice clause is kept in source order; its exact relation to the preceding collyrium form is not normalized.

roles.administration: ξηραί (dry roots); fill ulcers, and with honey clean/restore flesh over denuded bones
branch_effects: τὰ ἐψιλωμένα τῶν ὀστέων σαρκοῦσιν (flesh over denuded bones)

events.subject: Iris roots

roles.preparation: poultice with vinegar and ῥόδινον (rose preparation/oil)

events.scope_uncertainty: ῥόδινον is retained as a rose-derived preparation, without fixing its exact vehicle

roles.preparation: with white hellebore at double amount and honey, applied

compound_forms: ἀκόποι (historical compound term; exact scope uncertain)

events.subject: ἄκορον

roles.comparison: leaves like Iris but narrower; roots similar to Iris
roles.quality: dense and white, not worm-eaten, and full of fragrance is superior
roles.alternate_name: the Galatian form is called ἄσπληνον

events.scope_uncertainty: ἄβρωτον is rendered as not worm-eaten/undamaged in context; no modern species identification is asserted

effects: suit side, chest, and liver pains
reduce/dissolve spleen enlargement or material (scope historical)

chapters.name: μῆον Ἀθαμαντικόν (name retained; modern identification unresolved)

roles.comparison: stalk and leaves like dill, but thicker; about two cubits high

events.subject: μῆον roots

roles.alternative_preparation_2: λεῖαι δίχα ἑψήσεως (made smooth/fine without boiling)
body_or_condition: στεγνὰ περὶ κύστιν καὶ νεφρούς πάθη (στεγνά conditions around bladder/kidneys; exact sense unresolved: dry/obstructive/contracted)

events.scope_uncertainty: The Greek στεγνά is retained because “dry disorders” is not secure; dry, obstructive, or contracted conditions are possible historical senses. The two preparation alternatives and their shared drinking syntax are preserved, without choosing equivalence or a modern diagnosis.

events.subject: μῆον roots

roles.preparation: λεῖαι σὺν μέλιτι ἀντὶ ἐκλεικτοῦ (made smooth/fine with honey as an electuary/syrup form)

events.scope_uncertainty: ἀντὶ ἐκλεικτοῦ is retained as an administration-form phrase; it is not treated as a new ingredient

events.subject: μῆον roots

roles.effect: ἄγουσιν αἷμα δι᾿ ἐμμήνων (bring menstrual blood)

events.scope_uncertainty: the passage supplies the boiled form and sitz-bath route here; it does not supply a numerical dose

events.subject: μῆον roots
events.scope_uncertainty: ἐφηβαῖον is retained as the more specific pubic/lower-belly term; no broader body region is inferred

events.subject: μῆον when drunk

roles.condition: πλεῖον ἢ δεῖ πινόμενον (drunk in an amount more than needed)

events.scope_uncertainty: the final Greek sentence does not separately name a decoction in this adverse clause; no unspoken preparation state, dose threshold, or vehicle is added

conditions_and_limits: with-more-than-needed drunk as an adverse condition

interpretive_ceiling.note: The trace is a source-derived historical content model. It does not recommend treatments, map any target form to a Greek concept, or establish a complete target reading.

correction_log.correction: Initial “sword-like” wording was superseded: the comparator is now kept opaque as ξιφίῳ and linked only to the separately traced named ξιφίον in IV.20; no literal-sword or modern-taxon reading remains.
correction_log.basis: Wellmann I.1 and IV.20 main text; reciprocal comparison now documented in DIOSCORIDES_XIPHION_SOURCE.json.

correction_log.correction: Added γονατώδεις, στερεαί, εὐώδεις as root attributes in the opening identification event.
correction_log.basis: Wellmann main text I.1.1: ῥίζαι ... γονατώδεις, στερεαί, εὐώδεις.

correction_log.correction: Removed Libyan-only subject assignment; ageing remains a plural-root clause with unresolved antecedent scope.
correction_log.basis: Wellmann main text I.1.1: παλαιούμεναι δὲ τερηδονίζονται ...

correction_log.correction: Separated general Iris properties, the seven-drachm hydromel cleansing clause, and unqualified sleep/tear/colic effects.
correction_log.basis: Wellmann main text I.1.2 clause boundaries; dose retained only with πάχη/χολαί cleansing.

correction_log.correction: Removed “topical eye preparation”; retained collyrium form and application/insertion with route unresolved, and separated the later poultice clause.
correction_log.basis: Wellmann main text I.1.3: προστεθεῖσαι ... ὡς κολλύριον μετὰ μέλιτος ἔμβρυα κατασπῶσι.

correction_log.correction: Retained στεγνά with dry/obstructive/contracted possibilities; no modern disorder selected.
correction_log.basis: Wellmann main text I.3: τὰ στεγνὰ περὶ κύστιν καὶ νεφροὺς πάθη.

correction_log.correction: Retained excess drinking → headache only; no decoction, hidden dose, or vehicle added.
correction_log.basis: Wellmann main text I.3 final sentence.

correction_log.correction: Changed the comparator to opaque ξιφίῳ and linked it only to the separately traced named ξιφίον in IV.20, where the text explicitly compares ξιφίον with Iris as smaller and narrower.
